summary: Bell Canada announced results of its cash tender offers to purchase six series of debt securities. The Offers expired June 3, 2026, with a Guaranteed Delivery Date of June 5, 2026. Total consideration per $1,000 principal ranged from $665.35 to $810.81 depending on priority level. Aggregate principal validly tendered and accepted was US$877.543 million plus US$24.212 million in guaranteed deliveries. Settlement dates are June 5 and June 9, 2026. The notes are guaranteed by parent BCE Inc. This is an issuer tender offer, where the company repurchases its own outstanding debt to manage liabilities and reduce interest costs. Watch for final acceptance and potential impact on Bell's credit profile.
